name: The Kobeissi Letter
text:
BREAKING: An open letter to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO of Nvidia, $NVDA, now has over 65,000 signatures, alleging that Huang was removed "without meaningful due process."

The letter has been signed by more than 35,000 shareholders and 4,700 current and former Nvidia employees.

Elon Musk has publicly stated that he has signed the petition and fully supports Huang's return to the company.

We maintain our view that Huang was removed prematurely, without a conclusive investigation.

text:
BREAKING: Global equity funds attracted +$98 billion in inflows in the week ending November 11th, their 2nd-largest weekly inflow on record.

This marks the 5th consecutive weekly intake, totaling ~$350 billion.

As a result, the 4-week moving average of inflows is up to ~$75 billion, its largest reading on record.

By comparison, during the memestock mania in 2021, the 4-week average of inflows peaked at ~$45 billion.

Meanwhile, global equity technology funds attracted +$2.6 billion in the week ending November 11th, bringing their 3-week inflow up to +$9.1 billion.

Investors are aggressively buying the dip.
